findings.summary: The corroboration check can be satisfied by a coincidental mention: a skill whose authored prose quotes a stage table listing gate numbers would pass even where the declaration disagrees with its substantive claim
findings.evidence: Raised by the reviewer against this change. The check is a floor rather than a proof, and it closes the case that actually shipped, which was a declaration no authored sentence named at all

findings.summary: A user who wants a report to be a gate-bound artifact has no override: the path suffix decides, and the system now says so rather than stamping a block the runtime ignores
findings.evidence: The exclusion predates this change and this change only stops it being silent. Narrowing it would mean renaming what harness/runner.py writes, which is a wider change than this one
